skill.description: Arrow IPC file and Parquet interchange over the shared neutral Data snapshot model. No Lib-local capacity quotas.
skill.name: wasmc-data-interchange

apis.delta: Decode Arrow IPC file bytes into neutral batches. Capacity follows aggregate memory; type/schema/overflow checks remain.
Encode validated neutral batches as Arrow IPC file bytes. Capacity follows aggregate memory; type/schema/overflow checks remain.
Decode Parquet bytes into neutral batches. Capacity follows aggregate memory; type/schema/overflow checks remain.
Encode validated neutral batches as Parquet bytes. Capacity follows aggregate memory; type/schema/overflow checks remain.
